channel.title: The Dig — Application benchmarks
channel.description: Papers relevant to operating, benchmarking, integrating and using a semiconductor spin-qubit quantum computer of at least 16 qubits that is co-located with and integrated into an HPC system. Today's arXiv announcement, ranked against the Application benchmarks preset. Today’s ranked reading list leads with 2611.23448 on ADC-less cryogenic qubit readout, then moves through near-term control and compilation work in 2611.24328, 2611.24886, 2611.23923, and 2611.23786, before turning to longer-range fault-tolerance and QEC architecture papers 2611.23919, 2611.23420, and 2611.23528; the ordering reflects direct relevance to operating, calibrating, and scaling a spin-qubit QPU, with adjacent-platform and future error-correction results ranked lower.
